title: Count the common order statuses
prompt: Return status and orders, the number of orders with that status, for every status that has at least 10 orders. Put the status with the most orders first.
hints: One row per status, then keep only some of those rows.
The test on the count comes after GROUP BY.
GROUP BY status HAVING count(*) >= 10 ORDER BY orders DESC

wrongAnswers.misconception: Leaves out a status with exactly 10 orders.

feedback: Check the status that has exactly 10 orders, and the one that has only 1.
